private_watchlist.name: Blue Origin
private_watchlist.note: New Glenn's 2nd flight deployed NASA's ESCAPADE spacecraft and landed its booster; a May 28 hotfire anomaly has since delayed the return-to-flight timeline.

private_watchlist.name: Firefly Aerospace
private_watchlist.note: Alpha Block 2 debut planned; Blue Ghost Mission 2 targets a lunar far-side landing plus an ESA relay satellite deployment later in 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Stoke Space
private_watchlist.note: Converting Cape Canaveral LC-14 for Nova's first flight, planned later in 2026; named as a possible acquisition target amid AST SpaceMobile's capital raise.

bear_case.title: Capital intensity
bear_case.description: Rockets and constellations burn billions before returns; dilution is chronic among small caps.

bear_case.title: Government concentration
bear_case.description: Much of the sector's revenue is NASA/DoD; budget shifts reprice backlogs fast.

bear_case.title: SpaceX absorbs the value
bear_case.description: A dominant incumbent with launch-cost leverage can compress everyone else's margins — and SpaceX itself trades near 70-99x sales, ~15x the Nasdaq-100's multiple, with 2025 free cash flow of -$13.8B and Q1 2026 FCF of -$9.1B.

bear_case.title: Binary mission risk
bear_case.description: One failed landing or launch can halve a small-cap (see lunar-lander names); SpaceX's own prospectus flags "key man" dependence on Elon Musk.

catalysts.title: Rocket Lab agrees to acquire Iridium (~$8B)
catalysts.description: Cash-and-stock deal at $54/share hands RKLB Iridium's 500+ partner ecosystem and recurring cash flows ($871.7M 2025 revenue); closing targeted mid-2027.

catalysts.title: SDA awards $1.75B for Golden Dome Tranche 3
catalysts.description: L3Harris ($955M/18 sats) and Sierra Space ($798M/18 sats) will build accelerated missile-tracking satellites for 2028 launch readiness.

catalysts.title: Neutron upper-stage engine test succeeds
catalysts.description: Full-duration ~5.5-minute test keeps Rocket Lab on track for a Neutron debut targeted in Q4 2026.

catalysts.title: AST SpaceMobile raises $1B in convertible notes
catalysts.description: Dilution concerns drove the stock down ~59% from May highs; sparked speculation ASTS could acquire a launch company (Firefly, Relativity, Stoke named).

catalysts.title: SpaceX shares down ~40-44% from post-IPO high
catalysts.description: Broad space-sector sell-off plus looming August/September lockup expirations are weighing on sentiment across the group.

catalysts.title: Blue Origin New Glenn hotfire anomaly
catalysts.description: Follows a successful 2nd orbital flight (ESCAPADE deployment, booster landing); recovery work has delayed the next launch.
